_mo_ta: Kiem ke diem can media cua 7 cuon (M1, tang 0 thu nghiem 1). Moi diem co id on dinh (= khoa clip trong ma/schema: AUDIO/SPRITE/SPR, hoac p<trang>.fig<j>.i<k>, video.<id>). ngon_ngu[lang] = {trang_thai, ky_tu, dau_80, nguon_hien_co?, ghi_chu?}; lang "*" dung cho video_ma (khong phu thuoc ngon ngu). Khong chep nguyen van dai: chi ky_tu + 80 ky tu dau.

quy_uoc.co_san: co file am thanh thu san trong artifact va ma phat duoc
quy_uoc.thieu: chua co am thanh nao (ke ca TTS trinh duyet), hoac khoa clip tro toi file da go
quy_uoc.chi_tts_trinh_duyet: ma doc bang speechSynthesis cua trinh duyet (phu thuoc may nguoi xem, thuong khong co giong uz)

quy_uoc.mo_rong: diem co mo_rong=true: diem hinh kham pha (muc_dich diem_hinh*) chua duoc ma phat (kimyo8/fizika8 chua tung co audio; biologiya5 fx da co 1200 doan nhung chua noi va file da go 6/11): nhu cau de xuat, tong-hop.csv tach rieng
